'''Huttese Bantha hide leggings''' were a type of pants considered an item of medium [[Armor/Legends|armor]] worn during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. They were made from the hide of the [[Bantha/Legends|bantha]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. They were [[Color/Legends|yellow]] and gray in color.
